GROUP BY – rechnen für jede Gruppe: GROUP BY – calculating for each group
Wie viele Songs hat jedes Genre? Was ver: How many songs does each genre have? What do you earn on average in each town? Instead of writing a separate query for each group, you say with GROUP BY: form groups and calculate for each one separately. This is how the figures behind every bar chart in statistics, school report analyses and annual reports are made.
Alle Zeilen, die in einer Spalte denselb: All rows that have the same value in one column, e.g. all pop songs.
Zeilen in Gruppen zusammenfassen. In SQL: To put rows together into groups. In SQL: GROUP BY.
Für jede einzelne Gruppe: „Songs je Genr: For each single group: “songs per genre” = the count for each genre.
How many there are. In SQL: COUNT(*).
Mit AS gibst du einer Spalte im Ergebnis: With AS you give a column in the result a name: COUNT(*) AS anzahl.
Tonspur sucht Geldgeber. Für den Jahresb: Tonspur is looking for investors. For the annual report you need figures: not for the whole table songs, but for each genre, each artist, each year.
